cases.framing: Shape a legitimate fiscal institution that jointly sustains public revenue, equitable burden sharing, economic participation, and feasible administration.

new_nodes.name: System Shaping
new_nodes.capability: Intentionally configure or transform interacting structures so their combined behavior produces valued conditions over time.
new_nodes.accepts: A system whose structures, relationships, incentives, or capacities require deliberate change.
new_nodes.produces: A coherent system configuration aligned with desired behavior and viable operation.
new_nodes.boundary: Governs resolution through structural intervention in an interacting whole.
new_nodes.excludes: Explanation without change, isolated object repair, and expression whose value is primarily interpretive.

new_nodes.name: Institutional Arrangement Design
new_nodes.capability: Design durable rules, roles, incentives, and authorities that coordinate collective behavior.
new_nodes.accepts: Collective purposes, affected interests, behavioral mechanisms, authority, and enforcement constraints.
new_nodes.produces: A legitimate and operable institutional arrangement.
new_nodes.boundary: Shapes rule-governed collective interaction rather than a single transaction or physical artifact.
new_nodes.excludes: Purely technical architectures and informal advice without institutional force.

new_nodes.name: Tax System Design
new_nodes.capability: Configure compulsory public revenue collection so fiscal, distributive, behavioral, and administrative requirements remain jointly viable.
new_nodes.accepts: Revenue needs, economic structure, distributional aims, administrative capacity, and legitimacy constraints.
new_nodes.produces: An implementable tax architecture with rates, bases, collection rules, and safeguards.
new_nodes.boundary: Designs the tax system as an integrated institution.
new_nodes.excludes: Drafting one tax form or forecasting revenue under a fixed tax code.

new_nodes.name: Revenue Sufficiency
new_nodes.capability: Align a revenue system's yield, stability, and growth with public financing requirements.
new_nodes.accepts: Expenditure needs, candidate bases, rates, compliance assumptions, and economic scenarios.
new_nodes.produces: A resilient revenue envelope and financing mix.
new_nodes.boundary: Owns fiscal yield and stability.
new_nodes.excludes: Distributional legitimacy and collection operations.

new_nodes.name: Distributional Incidence
new_nodes.capability: Shape how institutional burdens and benefits fall across materially different groups.
new_nodes.accepts: Household and firm characteristics, candidate rules, behavioral responses, and equity principles.
new_nodes.produces: A distribution profile aligned with explicit fairness commitments.
new_nodes.boundary: Owns effective incidence rather than statutory labels.
new_nodes.excludes: Aggregate revenue sufficiency and administrative execution.

new_nodes.name: Administrative Operability
new_nodes.capability: Fit institutional rules to the state's ability to identify, assess, collect, enforce, and adjudicate.
new_nodes.accepts: Proposed rules, data availability, workforce, technology, informality, and enforcement capacity.
new_nodes.produces: Rules and processes that can be administered with tolerable cost and leakage.
new_nodes.boundary: Owns institutional executability.
new_nodes.excludes: Choosing distributive values or macroeconomic objectives.

new_nodes.name: Behavioral Alignment
new_nodes.capability: Align incentives and compliance conditions with desired participation while limiting harmful avoidance and distortion.
new_nodes.accepts: Candidate rules, actor responses, enforcement credibility, and valued activities.
new_nodes.produces: An incentive structure with anticipated adaptation and countermeasures.
new_nodes.boundary: Owns behavior induced by the arrangement.
new_nodes.excludes: Revenue accounting and moral judgment about burden sharing.

topology_edges.role: Resolve problems by deliberately shaping an interacting system.
topology_edges.rationale: System shaping is a broad resolution mode contrasted with explaining, diagnosing, or expressing without structural intervention.

topology_edges.role: Shape systems whose operative structure consists of collectively binding rules and roles.
topology_edges.rationale: Institutional design reveals legitimacy, authority, incentives, and enforcement as dimensions not shared by every system.

topology_edges.role: Realize institutional design through a public revenue arrangement.
topology_edges.rationale: A tax system is a particular rule-governed institution with compulsory collection and fiscal incidence.

topology_edges.role: Secure sufficient and stable public revenue.
topology_edges.rationale: A tax system cannot fulfill its fiscal purpose without adequate yield.

topology_edges.role: Determine the effective allocation of burdens.
topology_edges.rationale: Incidence can vary independently of total yield and is necessary for legitimacy.

topology_edges.role: Make assessment, collection, and enforcement feasible.
topology_edges.rationale: An elegant statutory design fails if the state cannot operate it.

topology_edges.role: Manage participation, compliance, avoidance, and economic distortion.
topology_edges.rationale: Tax rules alter behavior, which affects every other dimension.

abstraction_ascent.why_more_general: Institutional Arrangement Design covers tax systems and other durable rule-and-authority structures.
abstraction_ascent.reframing_effect: Makes legitimacy, authority, enforcement, and induced behavior visible alongside revenue mechanics.

abstraction_ascent.why_more_general: System Shaping covers institutional arrangements as one class of deliberately configured interacting systems.
abstraction_ascent.reframing_effect: Requires attention to cross-component behavior, viability, and adaptation over time.

abstraction_ascent.why_more_general: RootSolver includes system shaping and fundamentally different modes of resolution.
abstraction_ascent.reframing_effect: Places structural design under the universal constitution, understanding, synthesis, commitment, realization, and regulation scaffold.

abstraction_ascent.why_more_general: RootSolver is the universal boundary for every resolvable problem.
abstraction_ascent.reframing_effect: Ensures the fiscal design is governed as a complete problem rather than treated as a tax formula.

invocations.contribution: Govern the complete tax-system resolution.
Treat taxation as intervention in an adaptive social system.
Expose rules, authority, legitimacy, incentives, and enforcement.
Integrate the constitutive dimensions into one fiscal institution.
Estimate stable yields across growth, shocks, and compliance ranges.
Assess burdens by income, consumption, region, formality, and firm size.
Prefer observable bases and collection points compatible with limited capacity.
Limit evasion, informality traps, and penalties on productive participation.
Define the fiscal gap, development objectives, affected groups, and state-capacity boundary.
Model the economy, informality, compliance, incidence, and revenue leakage.
Construct alternative mixes of broad bases, progressive instruments, and simplified regimes.
Select a legitimate mix robust to uncertainty and political tradeoffs.
Phase legislation, registration, withholding, administration, and taxpayer support.
Track yield, incidence, compliance, distortion, and revise thresholds or enforcement.

cases.synthesis: A viable tax system emerges when sufficient revenue, fair effective incidence, administrable rules, and behaviorally credible incentives reinforce one another rather than optimizing one dimension in isolation.
cases.proposed_solution: Adopt a broad, low-rate consumption base with exemptions or targeted transfers for essentials; progressive personal income taxation concentrated on observable higher incomes; simple turnover-to-profit transition rules for small firms; and selective property, resource, and excise taxes. Phase implementation around withholding, digital invoicing, taxpayer IDs, independent appeals, and published incidence reviews, adjusting thresholds as administrative capacity and formal participation grow.

cases.framing: Reshape the care system surrounding heart-failure discharge so clinical stability, patient capability, continuity, and early feedback jointly prevent avoidable returns.

new_nodes.name: Service System Shaping
new_nodes.capability: Shape interactions, handoffs, capacity, and feedback through which a service produces outcomes for recipients.
new_nodes.accepts: A recurring service journey with multiple actors, touchpoints, constraints, and outcome failures.
new_nodes.produces: A coordinated service system capable of reliable recipient outcomes.
new_nodes.boundary: Owns the whole service-producing arrangement across encounters.
new_nodes.excludes: A single professional act or a product operating without a service journey.

new_nodes.name: Care Outcome Improvement
new_nodes.capability: Improve health outcomes by reshaping the clinical and supportive care system around a defined population.
new_nodes.accepts: A population, preventable adverse outcomes, care mechanisms, and delivery constraints.
new_nodes.produces: An evidence-calibrated care configuration reducing avoidable harm.
new_nodes.boundary: Targets population outcomes through care-system change.
new_nodes.excludes: Treatment selection for one isolated encounter.

new_nodes.name: Heart-Failure Readmission Reduction
new_nodes.capability: Reduce avoidable post-discharge hospital returns among heart-failure patients while preserving safety and access.
new_nodes.accepts: Heart-failure admissions, discharge conditions, patient risks, community capacity, and readmission evidence.
new_nodes.produces: A risk-sensitive transition and follow-up system with measurable readmission reduction.
new_nodes.boundary: Owns the transition from inpatient stabilization through early community recovery.
new_nodes.excludes: Preventing clinically necessary readmission by withholding care.

new_nodes.name: Clinical Stability
new_nodes.capability: Establish and preserve sufficient physiological stability for safe transition between care settings.
new_nodes.accepts: Clinical status, treatment response, comorbidities, and deterioration risks.
new_nodes.produces: Explicit stability conditions and escalation triggers.
new_nodes.boundary: Owns clinical readiness and deterioration risk.
new_nodes.excludes: Patient learning and cross-provider coordination.

new_nodes.name: Self-Care Capability
new_nodes.capability: Enable recipients and caregivers to perform the understanding, monitoring, and action required between service encounters.
new_nodes.accepts: Required behaviors, literacy, resources, preferences, and caregiver availability.
new_nodes.produces: Demonstrated capability with barriers and supports addressed.
new_nodes.boundary: Owns recipient agency outside formal encounters.
new_nodes.excludes: Clinical stabilization and provider capacity.

new_nodes.name: Continuity Coordination
new_nodes.capability: Preserve responsibility, information, and treatment coherence across organizational and temporal handoffs.
new_nodes.accepts: Care plan, actors, records, dependencies, and handoff risks.
new_nodes.produces: Named ownership and reliable cross-setting continuity.
new_nodes.boundary: Owns linkage across care boundaries.
new_nodes.excludes: The content of clinical treatment itself.

new_nodes.name: Early Risk Detection
new_nodes.capability: Detect worsening conditions early enough for a lower-intensity corrective response.
new_nodes.accepts: Risk markers, patient reports, measurements, and response capacity.
new_nodes.produces: Timely alerts linked to proportionate escalation.
new_nodes.boundary: Owns surveillance-to-response latency.
new_nodes.excludes: Long-term outcome evaluation without immediate action.

topology_edges.role: Shape systems that produce outcomes through recurring service interactions.
topology_edges.rationale: Service systems add journeys, encounters, handoffs, recipient participation, and capacity matching.

topology_edges.role: Shape care services around population health outcomes.
topology_edges.rationale: Care improvement adds clinical safety, patient vulnerability, and health-outcome obligations.

topology_edges.role: Improve a care outcome by preventing avoidable heart-failure readmissions.
topology_edges.rationale: This specializes care improvement around a particular transition, population, and adverse outcome.

topology_edges.role: Secure safe physiological transition.
topology_edges.rationale: Readmission prevention cannot be safe without clinical stability.

topology_edges.role: Make the between-visit regimen performable.
topology_edges.rationale: Outcomes depend on patient and caregiver action after discharge.

topology_edges.role: Maintain coherent responsibility across settings.
topology_edges.rationale: Fragmented handoffs independently generate medication and follow-up failures.

topology_edges.role: Recognize and intercept deterioration.
topology_edges.rationale: Heart failure can worsen rapidly even after an initially sound transition.

abstraction_ascent.why_more_general: Care Outcome Improvement covers this and other population-level care failures.
abstraction_ascent.reframing_effect: Moves attention from discharge instructions alone to the whole causal care configuration.

abstraction_ascent.why_more_general: Service System Shaping covers care improvement as one safety-critical service application.
abstraction_ascent.reframing_effect: Exposes journeys, handoffs, recipient participation, capacity, and feedback.

abstraction_ascent.why_more_general: System Shaping includes service systems and other interacting structures.
abstraction_ascent.reframing_effect: Frames readmission as emergent system behavior requiring coordinated structural change.

abstraction_ascent.why_more_general: RootSolver includes system shaping and non-shaping forms of resolution.
abstraction_ascent.reframing_effect: Subjects the intervention to the universal resolution scaffold.

abstraction_ascent.why_more_general: RootSolver is the universal problem-solving boundary.
abstraction_ascent.reframing_effect: Integrates framing, evidence, choice, enactment, and learning.

invocations.contribution: Govern the complete readmission-reduction resolution.
Treat readmission as adaptive system behavior.
Expose the end-to-end patient journey and handoffs.
Center safe population outcomes rather than utilization alone.
Integrate safe transition, capability, continuity, and detection.
Use explicit discharge readiness, medication reconciliation, and congestion criteria.
Verify teach-back, daily monitoring, medication access, diet feasibility, and caregiver support.
Assign a transition owner and transmit one reconciled plan to community clinicians.
Risk-tier follow-up and connect warning signals to same-day intervention.
Define avoidable readmission, safety countermetrics, population, and follow-up horizon.
Segment causes across instability, access, adherence, comorbidity, and fragmented care.
Construct risk-tiered bundles rather than one uniform program.
Choose a bundle by benefit, equity, burden, and staffing robustness.
Embed ownership, scheduling, information transfer, and escalation in workflow.
Track readmissions, mortality, emergency visits, patient burden, and subgroup equity.

cases.synthesis: Avoidable readmissions fall when physiological readiness, practical self-care, cross-setting continuity, and rapid interception operate as one transition system, with safety metrics preventing utilization reduction from becoming care denial.
cases.proposed_solution: Deploy a risk-tiered transition bundle: objective discharge-readiness and medication reconciliation; teach-back with affordability and caregiver checks; a booked follow-up within seven days, sooner for high-risk patients; one accountable transition clinician; and daily weight/symptom surveillance linked to same-day diuretic or clinic pathways. Evaluate 30- and 90-day readmissions alongside mortality, emergency visits, patient burden, and equity.

cases.framing: Transform a live software system's responsibility structure while continuously preserving externally required behavior and reversibility.

new_nodes.name: Software System Shaping
new_nodes.capability: Shape computational responsibilities, interfaces, state, and operational qualities into a coherent software system.
new_nodes.accepts: Required behaviors, existing or proposed software structures, workloads, and operational constraints.
new_nodes.produces: A software architecture whose component interactions sustain required qualities.
new_nodes.boundary: Owns software-wide structural coherence and operational behavior.
new_nodes.excludes: Implementing an isolated function without architectural consequences.

new_nodes.name: Continuity-Preserving System Evolution
new_nodes.capability: Transform a functioning system incrementally while preserving critical service and maintaining recovery paths.
new_nodes.accepts: A live system, target structural change, continuity obligations, dependencies, and operational evidence.
new_nodes.produces: A staged transformation with bounded exposure and reversible transitions.
new_nodes.boundary: Owns structural change under uninterrupted-operation constraints.
new_nodes.excludes: Greenfield design and transformations that permit a full shutdown.

new_nodes.name: Monolith-to-Microservices Migration
new_nodes.capability: Redistribute a monolith's capabilities, state, and operations into independently evolvable services without user-visible downtime.
new_nodes.accepts: A live monolith, domain behavior, dependency structure, reliability objectives, and delivery capacity.
new_nodes.produces: A staged service architecture with preserved behavior and controlled cutover.
new_nodes.boundary: Owns the architectural transition rather than advocating microservices in principle.
new_nodes.excludes: A big-bang rewrite or arbitrary codebase partitioning.

new_nodes.name: Responsibility Boundaries
new_nodes.capability: Partition system behavior into cohesive ownership units with explicit contracts.
new_nodes.accepts: Business capabilities, change coupling, data dependencies, and team ownership.
new_nodes.produces: Bounded responsibilities and stable interaction contracts.
new_nodes.boundary: Owns semantic and ownership separation.
new_nodes.excludes: Traffic cutover and runtime observability.

new_nodes.name: State Continuity
new_nodes.capability: Preserve correctness and authority of changing state while ownership moves across system boundaries.
new_nodes.accepts: Data models, invariants, writes, reads, migration stages, and failure modes.
new_nodes.produces: Explicit state ownership, synchronization, reconciliation, and cutover rules.
new_nodes.boundary: Owns state correctness during transition.
new_nodes.excludes: Service responsibility selection.

new_nodes.name: Traffic Transition
new_nodes.capability: Shift live interactions between old and new realizations without violating availability or behavior.
new_nodes.accepts: Compatible implementations, routing controls, capacity evidence, and rollback conditions.
new_nodes.produces: A progressive, observable, and reversible cutover.
new_nodes.boundary: Owns live request or event routing during replacement.
new_nodes.excludes: Defining component semantics and long-term data ownership.

new_nodes.name: Operational Observability
new_nodes.capability: Make system behavior, degradation, dependencies, and change effects detectable at actionable resolution.
new_nodes.accepts: Runtime interactions, service objectives, telemetry, and failure hypotheses.
new_nodes.produces: Correlated signals and decision thresholds for safe operation.
new_nodes.boundary: Owns operational visibility.
new_nodes.excludes: Performing remediation or defining business boundaries.

topology_edges.role: Define coherent service responsibilities.
topology_edges.rationale: Independent evolution requires meaningful boundaries rather than technical slicing.

topology_edges.role: Preserve data invariants while ownership changes.
topology_edges.rationale: Correct service behavior depends on authoritative and consistent state.

topology_edges.rationale: No-downtime migration requires progressive traffic control.

topology_edges.rationale: Safe progression and rollback require actionable evidence.

abstraction_ascent.why_more_general: Software System Shaping includes live evolution and greenfield architectural formation.

invocations.contribution: Govern the complete migration resolution.
Treat migration as transformation of interacting structures.
Expose responsibilities, interfaces, state, and runtime qualities.
Make compatibility, bounded exposure, and reversibility governing constraints.
Integrate boundaries, state, traffic, and observability.
Extract around business capability, change coupling, and accountable ownership.
Assign authoritative writes and use reconciliation for temporary replication.
Use strangler routing, shadowing, canaries, and explicit rollback thresholds.
Correlate traces, errors, latency, saturation, and business invariants across both paths.
Define why services are needed, zero-downtime SLOs, scope, and acceptable transitional complexity.
Map change coupling, runtime dependencies, data invariants, load, and failure propagation.
Generate extraction sequences and coexistence mechanisms.
Select increments by value, coupling, risk, and rollback strength.
Build compatibility seams, migrate one bounded capability, and progressively cut over.
Gate each increment on SLOs, invariants, operability, and learning.

cases.synthesis: A safe migration emerges from coherent responsibility boundaries, authoritative state transitions, reversible traffic movement, and observability strong enough to decide whether each increment should advance or retreat.
cases.proposed_solution: Use a strangler migration, beginning with a low-coupling, high-change business capability. Establish contracts and observability first; extract behavior behind compatible routing; keep one authoritative writer per datum; shadow reads and reconcile replicas; then canary traffic with automated rollback against availability, latency, error, and business-invariant thresholds. Retire monolith paths only after sustained evidence, repeating capability by capability.

cases.framing: Configure a week of family nourishment under intersecting safety constraints while preserving nutritional adequacy, acceptance, variety, and practical household flow.

new_nodes.name: Provision Configuration Design
new_nodes.capability: Configure a bounded set of consumable provisions so safety, adequacy, preference, resources, and repeated use remain jointly viable.
new_nodes.accepts: Recipient needs, consumable options, hazards, resources, preferences, and a provision horizon.
new_nodes.produces: A coherent provision configuration across recipients and occasions.
new_nodes.boundary: Owns selection and arrangement of consumable offerings.
new_nodes.excludes: Agricultural production and isolated preparation technique.

new_nodes.name: Household Meal-Plan Design
new_nodes.capability: Configure meals across a household and time horizon so members can eat safely, adequately, acceptably, and practically.
new_nodes.accepts: Household members, allergy constraints, nutrition needs, preferences, schedule, budget, and kitchen capacity.
new_nodes.produces: A feasible meal schedule with shared components and safe adaptations.
new_nodes.boundary: Owns the multi-day household meal configuration.
new_nodes.excludes: Clinical allergy diagnosis and preparation of one dish.

new_nodes.name: Safety Compatibility
new_nodes.capability: Ensure every offered provision and its handling remain compatible with recipient-specific hazards and exclusions.
new_nodes.accepts: Recipient hazard profiles, ingredients, substitutions, handling paths, and contamination risks.
new_nodes.produces: A recipient-by-offering safety map with controlled preparation rules.
new_nodes.boundary: Owns hazard exclusion and cross-contact control.
new_nodes.excludes: Nutritional adequacy and taste preference.

new_nodes.name: Nutritional Coverage
new_nodes.capability: Compose provisions whose combined nutrient and energy profile adequately covers recipients over the relevant horizon.
new_nodes.accepts: Recipient requirements, portions, ingredients, and temporal consumption pattern.
new_nodes.produces: An adequate nutritional profile with material gaps exposed.
new_nodes.boundary: Owns aggregate nourishment across time.
new_nodes.excludes: Allergen safety and culinary identity.

new_nodes.name: Recipient Acceptance
new_nodes.capability: Fit provisions to preferences, familiarity, autonomy, and sensory tolerance sufficiently for actual uptake.
new_nodes.accepts: Recipient preferences, aversions, cultural expectations, and candidate offerings.
new_nodes.produces: An offering set likely to be willingly consumed.
new_nodes.boundary: Owns practical acceptability.
new_nodes.excludes: Hazard safety and resource efficiency.

new_nodes.name: Preparation Flow
new_nodes.capability: Arrange preparation, storage, reuse, and serving so a provision configuration is feasible with available time and facilities.
new_nodes.accepts: Menu components, kitchen capacity, schedule, storage, and handling constraints.
new_nodes.produces: A workable production and serving pattern.
new_nodes.boundary: Owns household operational flow.
new_nodes.excludes: Nutritional valuation and preference formation.

topology_edges.role: Shape systems of consumable provisions across recipients and occasions.
topology_edges.rationale: Provision design reveals safety, adequacy, acceptance, resource, and temporal-use dimensions.

topology_edges.rationale: Household planning specializes provision design around repeated meals, shared preparation, and member-specific needs.

topology_edges.rationale: Safety is non-negotiable and can vary independently of nutritional quality.

topology_edges.role: Cover nourishment across the week.
topology_edges.rationale: A safe plan can still fail if aggregate nutrition is inadequate.

topology_edges.rationale: Meals provide no nourishment if recipients will not eat them.

topology_edges.role: Make preparation and reuse feasible.
topology_edges.rationale: The plan must fit household time, storage, equipment, and contamination controls.

abstraction_ascent.reframing_effect: Makes adequacy, safety, acceptance, resources, and use across occasions jointly visible.

abstraction_ascent.reframing_effect: Treats the week as a coupled allocation and flow system rather than seven unrelated recipes.

abstraction_ascent.reframing_effect: Places meal configuration under universal framing, evidence, design, commitment, realization, and feedback.

invocations.contribution: Govern the complete meal-plan resolution.
Treat the week as a coupled household system.
Expose safety, adequacy, acceptance, resources, and repeated use.
Integrate safe shared components into a practical week.
Build an allergy matrix and control labels, utensils, surfaces, storage, and substitutions.
Balance protein, energy, fiber, produce, fats, and relevant micronutrients across seven days.
Use familiar bases, optional toppings, and planned choice without unsafe parallel meals.
Batch safe staples and deliberately reuse components within storage limits.
Record each allergy, severity, cross-contact rule, nutrition need, budget, schedule, and equipment limit.
Map ingredient hazards, substitution effects, family acceptance, and preparation bottlenecks.
Create several safe weekly patterns from compatible meal templates.
Choose the plan by safety first, then adequacy, acceptance, cost, and workload.
Translate the plan into verified purchases, batch preparation, labels, and serving controls.
Track reactions, leftovers, refusals, cost, and workload, then rotate meals safely.

cases.synthesis: A workable allergy-aware week emerges when safety compatibility governs every ingredient and handling path while nutrition, acceptance, and preparation flow make the safe plan sustainable enough to be followed.
cases.proposed_solution: First create a member-by-allergen matrix and verify every label and cross-contact rule. Build the week from universally safe bases: rice or potatoes, tolerated legumes or meats, vegetables, fruit, and safe fats. Rotate bowls, tray bakes, soups, tacos with safe wraps, pasta alternatives, and leftovers. Offer toppings separately, batch-cook staples, label portions, and have a clinician review nutritional substitutions for severe or numerous exclusions.

cases.synthesis: Effective SaaS pricing emerges when the charging metric tracks customer value, packaging makes competitive position legible, tiers enable honest self-selection, and resulting unit economics can fund a reliable evolving service.
cases.proposed_solution: Launch three transparent tiers around one value-correlated metric: a low-friction starter for proof, a core tier containing the complete primary workflow, and an enterprise tier for governance, security, scale, and support. Benchmark competitors but set levels from customer-value interviews and willingness tests. Avoid permanent deep discounts; use time-boxed pilots. Review conversion, activation, retention, expansion, gross margin, and discount leakage by segment.

cases.framing: Configure scarce emergency-care attention so urgency, time sensitivity, available capability, and uncertainty produce safe and equitable treatment priority.

new_nodes.name: Care Allocation Design

new_nodes.accepts: Patient needs, urgency evidence, scarce capabilities, timing, and ethical constraints.

new_nodes.boundary: Owns priority among care demands under scarcity.
new_nodes.excludes: Complete treatment planning after allocation.

new_nodes.name: Rural Emergency Triage Design
new_nodes.capability: Prioritize rural emergency patients safely under limited diagnostics, staffing, beds, and transfer access.
new_nodes.accepts: Presentations, vital signs, risk indicators, local capability, transfer conditions, and uncertainty.
new_nodes.produces: A simple acuity protocol with immediate actions, reassessment, and escalation paths.
new_nodes.boundary: Owns initial and continuing priority until definitive disposition.
new_nodes.excludes: Replacing clinical judgment or providing definitive diagnosis.

new_nodes.name: Clinical Urgency Discrimination
new_nodes.capability: Differentiate care needs by severity and time-dependent consequence rather than presentation order.
new_nodes.accepts: Symptoms, vital signs, risk indicators, and observed deterioration.
new_nodes.produces: An acuity classification with immediate safety actions.
new_nodes.boundary: Owns urgency classification.
new_nodes.excludes: Capacity assignment and definitive diagnosis.

new_nodes.name: Capability Matching
new_nodes.capability: Match a need to the lowest available setting capable of safely meeting it, including escalation beyond local capacity.
new_nodes.accepts: Need classification, local resources, staff competencies, transport, and receiving options.
new_nodes.produces: A feasible care destination and resource assignment.
new_nodes.boundary: Owns fit between need and available capability.
new_nodes.excludes: Judging intrinsic clinical urgency.

new_nodes.name: Equitable Priority
new_nodes.capability: Ensure allocation priority follows relevant need and benefit rather than irrelevant status, access, or bias.
new_nodes.accepts: Candidate priority rules, affected groups, access barriers, and ethical obligations.
new_nodes.produces: Fair priority safeguards and bias checks.
new_nodes.boundary: Owns distributive legitimacy of allocation.
new_nodes.excludes: Medical diagnosis and resource mobilization.

new_nodes.name: Dynamic Reassessment

new_nodes.accepts: Initial classification, elapsed time, new observations, and resource changes.

new_nodes.excludes: Initial treatment performance.

cases.synthesis: Safe rural triage emerges when clinical urgency determines initial priority, capability matching connects need to feasible care, equity constrains allocation, and repeated reassessment prevents a provisional category from becoming stale.
cases.proposed_solution: Use a four-tier protocol: immediate resuscitation; emergent clinician assessment within minutes; urgent assessment within a defined short window; and stable low-acuity care. Pair danger-sign checklists with vital signs and clinician override. Each tier must specify stabilization, diagnostics, reassessment interval, and transfer triggers. Re-triage on deterioration or delay, maintain direct referral links, and audit under-triage, over-triage, waiting harm, transfers, and equity.

invocations.contribution: Govern the complete trading-system design.
Treat the platform as an interacting adaptive system.
Expose responsibilities, interfaces, state, and operational qualities.
Center event, time, state, and recovery contracts.
Integrate event flow with risk, execution, audit, and resilience.
Version typed market, signal, order, risk, execution, and position events.
Define partition ordering, clock use, concurrency, deadlines, and replay behavior.

cases.synthesis: A trustworthy real-time trading system emerges when precise event semantics and temporal rules preserve deterministic decisions, state integrity protects financial invariants, failure containment limits harm, and observability makes every transition auditable.
cases.proposed_solution: Partition streams by the smallest key requiring order, such as instrument or account, and use versioned typed events. Keep pre-trade risk synchronous on the order path, make every order transition idempotent, and maintain authoritative position and limit state with reconciliation. Use durable logs for replay, bounded queues and backpressure, isolated strategy workers, kill switches, correlated tracing, and percentile latency budgets validated under burst and dependency-failure tests.

cases.synthesis: A productive academy emerges when cumulative capability progression meets meaningful opportunity, whole-person sustainability, fair longitudinal judgment, senior-team alignment, and a credible destination interface rather than optimizing youth results.
cases.proposed_solution: Create age-flexible foundation, formation, performance, and transition stages with individualized plans across technical, tactical, physical, psychological, and social capabilities. Review players longitudinally with maturation-adjusted evidence. Give each prospect a first-team sponsor and explicit routes through older groups, training, loans, and debuts. Protect education, health, safeguarding, and identity; support released players. Measure senior minutes, sustained progression, availability, wellbeing, education, and equity—not youth trophies.

summary: The batch establishes System Shaping as the evidenced broad resolution mode, then differentiates institutional, service, software, provision, and organizational families. Later cases reuse and deepen those families through pricing, care allocation, reactive architecture, menu design, and talent development. Every case routes from RootSolver through its exact ascent and invokes all six universal problem-solving dimensions before producing a concrete proposal.
